source.check: deemed re-elected (no nomination): retiring member named by the source as returned without a poll (Larne Times, 7 May 1927, p. 2 ("Larne Rural Council: nomination day"), image-read)

note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled on Thursday 2 June 1927. The Larne Times nomination-day report lists all 16 district electoral divisions: contests in Ardclinis and Cairncastle; Islandmagee South left with one nominee after the retiring member withdrew; 11 other divisions with a single nominee; no nominations for Ballycorr and Templecorran, whose retiring members were deemed re-elected. The first meeting of the new council (LT 11 June 1927) names sixteen elected members. No nomination; retiring member deemed re-elected. The surname's middle letters are lost at the faded page edge; 'Mr. Hogsett' speaks as a member at the council's monthly meeting (LT 18 Jun 1927 p4). Deemed re-elected (no nomination). Uncertain: surname read as Hogsett from the partly illegible print, supported by LT 18 Jun 1927 p4 (c_0001531_19270618_4_0_3150_520_3360_1400_c0.jpg) and by the Larne Times list of members at the 1930 dissolution, 'Templecorran - James Hogsett' (LT 10 May 1930 p8, c_0001531_19300510_8_1480_2330_2010_2720_1500_c1.jpg).
